title: Sapphire Carré Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
Blue, squared off. A tennis bracelet of square princess cut sapphire blue cubic zirconia of about 4mm, each stone in its own square gold four claw setting and linked edge to edge, so the line reads as one unbroken band of deep colour. It closes with a slim fold over clasp. The stones are blue cubic zirconia rather than sapphire. Wear it to an evening reception, or with crisp white when you want one deep note of colour.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with a clear line bracelet so the blue sits between two rows of light.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Square princess cut sapphire blue cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm each
  • Setting: Square gold four claw settings, linked edge to edge
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Stone note: Blue cubic zirconia, not sapphire
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
